meta.title: QuietJar pricing - 5% per donation, minimum €0.50
meta.description: QuietJar takes 5% of each donation, minimum €0.50, and pays all the card fees. No monthly fee, no plans, no cap. See exactly what you keep on any amount.

hero.heading: Of each donation you receive. That is the whole price.
hero.sub: Never less than €0.50, and never more than 5%. We pay the card fees ourselves, so what you receive does not depend on how your supporter chose to pay.
trustBar: We pay all the card fees

example.title: What you keep
example.intro: Pick an amount and see exactly what lands in your account. Nothing else comes off.
example.noscriptIntro: A few common amounts, without the calculator:

methods.title: How your supporters can pay
methods.text: Whatever they reach for, you receive the same. The cost difference is ours, not yours.
methods.note: Which methods appear depends on where your account is registered and where your supporter is.

items.text: The payment happens right where your supporter already is, so far more of them make it all the way to "thank you."

items.lead: Pays the way people already do
items.text: Wallets and local methods like iDEAL are built in, so your supporters use the payment method they already trust.
Once someone has supported you, the button steps back and thanks them instead of asking again.
Add a goal with a progress bar, and leave the upkeep to us.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.text: Stripe pays your balance into your bank account automatically, every day. There is no manual step, and QuietJar charges nothing extra for it.

items.name: Which payment methods can my supporters use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, and local methods like iDEAL, Bancontact, EPS, Revolut Pay and BLIK. Your supporters see the method they already use, not an unfamiliar form.
Stripe pays out your balance to your bank account automatically, every day. There is no manual step on your side.

items.name: Does the fee change with volume?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There are no tiers and no cap. Everyone pays the same 5%, from the first donation onward, with a €0.50 minimum on the small ones.

Every donation costs us something to process, and on a €1 donation 5% does not cover it. The floor applies to donations up to €10, since 5% of €10 is exactly €0.50, and the percentage takes over above that.
We do. They come out of our 5%, not out of your balance. That is why a donation on a non-EU credit card leaves you exactly as much as the same donation on iDEAL.

items.name: Do my supporters need an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They pay on your page in a couple of taps, with nothing to sign up for.
Refunds go through Stripe like any other payment. We are finalizing the exact policy before launch - get in touch if you need one sooner.

items.name: How is this different from a hosted donation page with a free tier?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most free tiers still send your supporter to someone else's page to pay. The real question is not the fee - it is how many visitors finish the trip after that redirect.

closing.text: A quiet way to accept support, live on your site in minutes.
